learning_objective: 🎯 Become a champion for the arts by learning how to use your creativity to spread important messages and organize brilliant exhibitions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Art is one of the most powerful ways to grab people's attention! A bold poster or a dramatic street play can spread awareness about important topics like saving water or protecting animals.
An exhibition is a special event where artists proudly display their work to the public. It takes careful planning to frame the artworks, arrange the lighting, and guide visitors through the gallery.
When you campaign for art awareness, you show people how valuable creativity is. You encourage others to pick up a paintbrush, watch a play, and respect the hard work of all artists.

fun_activity.title: 📢 The Change-Maker Poster
fun_activity.instructions: Design a bright, eye-catching poster for your school with a powerful slogan like 'Keep Our Planet Green'. Make sure the main image is huge and the message is super easy to read from far away!

quick_recap: ⭐ Art is a brilliant tool for visual communication, helping to spread important social messages quickly and powerfully.
⭐ Hosting an art exhibition requires teamwork to properly curate, arrange, and display artworks for the public.
⭐ Running an art campaign teaches the community to value creativity and supports the growth of local artists.
